jobs.name: basedpyright/type-check
jobs.not_applicable: notice naming the absent Python source/type patterns

jobs.name: lint/rust-lint
jobs.applicable_when: at least one tracked rust/**/src/**/*.rs exists
jobs.not_applicable: notice naming the absent Rust source pattern

jobs.name: lint/python-lint
jobs.applicable_when: at least one tracked .py file exists
jobs.not_applicable: notice naming the absent Python source pattern

jobs.name: lint/web-check
jobs.applicable_when: web/package.json, lockfile, and tracked web/src source exist
jobs.not_applicable: notice naming each absent Web prerequisite

jobs.name: nix-source-filter-check/check-source-filter
jobs.applicable_when: always; an empty future source directory set is a valid checked state
jobs.implementation_status: planned Nix app; current workflow has an inline check

jobs.name: pytest/test-linux
jobs.not_applicable: notice naming both absent pytest collection patterns

jobs.name: release/rust-publish
jobs.applicable_when: a v* tag is pushed and every declared publishable Rust artifact exists
jobs.not_applicable: workflow is not triggered outside v* tags; missing declared artifacts on a tag is an error
jobs.implementation_status: obsolete crate list recorded in foundation path audit

jobs.name: release/python-publish
jobs.applicable_when: a v* tag is pushed, Rust publication succeeds, and the PyO3 package exists
jobs.not_applicable: workflow is not triggered outside v* tags; missing artifacts on a tag is an error
jobs.implementation_status: planned replacement of direct host toolchain actions

jobs.name: release/github-release
jobs.applicable_when: a v* tag is pushed and all package jobs and signed artifact checks succeed
jobs.not_applicable: workflow is not triggered outside v* tags; missing artifacts on a tag is an error

jobs.name: remote-flake/remote-flake-run
jobs.applicable_when: metadata always; app execution after server and Web sources exist
jobs.not_applicable: app substeps emit a notice naming absent server/Web sources; metadata is never skipped

jobs.name: remote-flake/local-flake-run
jobs.applicable_when: flake evaluation always; app execution after server and Web sources exist
jobs.not_applicable: app substeps emit a notice naming absent server/Web sources; evaluation must remain applicable
jobs.implementation_status: phase 2 must move evaluation outside the legacy source guard

jobs.name: ruff/ruff
jobs.applicable_when: at least one tracked .py file exists
jobs.not_applicable: notice naming the absent Python source pattern

jobs.name: rust-ci/build
jobs.command: nix run .#clippy && nix run .#build-rust && nix run .#cargo-test
jobs.applicable_when: at least one tracked rust/**/src/**/*.rs exists
jobs.not_applicable: notice naming the absent Rust source pattern

jobs.name: spa-404-check/spa-404-check
jobs.applicable_when: server main, Web package, lockfile, and tracked web/src source exist
jobs.not_applicable: notice naming each absent server/Web prerequisite
jobs.implementation_status: planned Nix app; current workflow uses obsolete src-server paths
